result.title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
result.summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出 OSFP4，通过联合优化对角平滑矩阵与分块缩放因子来降低 NVFP4 量化在 LLM 线性层中的矩阵乘积误差，并保持接近厂商 NVFP4 的推理吞吐。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于纯数值精度与量化效率的推理加速工作，未涉及多模态推理状态、视觉证据使用或 latent 生成与决策机制，与 LVR/VLM 推理主线缺少实质联系。
